key_memories.summary: Awakening assessment: Awakened at Rank F with Threat Sense.
Rent deadline: Paid ¥8,000 rent in full.
Guild registration: Aiko Sato issued an F-rank license; travel and filing cost ¥280.

Gate mission: Cleared Tunnel Slime Nest inside Frostbound Platform (ice; hazard: whiteout) in clear weather (roll 76 vs 50) for ¥5,400 and 10 rank points; gained 2 ability exposure; fare cost ¥240. Discovered Frostbound Platform: an arriving ghost train. Investigation reached 25%. Mei later reacted to the Frostbound Platform report: “Describe the anomaly. Leave theories out of it.”

Gate mission: Cleared Tunnel Slime Nest inside Ashen Shopping Arcade (urban ruin; hazard: cinder wind) in clear weather (roll 71 vs 49) for ¥5,400 and 10 rank points; gained 2 ability exposure; fare cost ¥0. Discovered Ashen Shopping Arcade: a working payphone. Investigation reached 25%. Mei later reacted to the Ashen Shopping Arcade report: “Describe the anomaly. Leave theories out of it.” Promoted to Rank E!
